layout: Three six-pose left-facing attack sheets. Source PNGs copied unchanged, alpha preserved. Source bounds and foot anchors in src/heroAttackArt.ts compensate for generated atlas spacing. Two small SVG clip regions separate the sweep blade from the neighboring frame.
